seoTitle: Chesterfield County Public Schools Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates
seoDescription: Chesterfield County Public Schools (CCPS) 2026–27 calendar: Aug. 24–25 start, June 4 last day, holidays, early-release dates, breaks, and calendar download.
heroSourceLine: Based on CCPS’s approved 2026–27 traditional calendar · 178 instructional days
heroSummary: Chesterfield County Public Schools uses a staggered start for 2026–27. Students in grades 1–5, 6, and 9 start Monday, August 24, while grades 7–8 and 10–12 start Tuesday, August 25. Pre-K and kindergarten students follow a separate staggered schedule through August 27, with all Pre-K and kindergarten students attending daily beginning August 28. The last day of school is June 4, 2027.

customSections.content: CCPS uses separate opening schedules for grade groups and for Pre-K and kindergarten. Families should use the date that applies to each child rather than treating August 24 as a districtwide first day.

whatsNew.title: What Changed From 2025–26
content: The first day for grades 1–5, 6, and 9 moves from August 18 to August 24. The first day for grades 7–8 and 10–12 moves from August 19 to August 25.
The scheduled last day moves from May 29 to June 4.
Spring Break shifts from March 30–April 3 in 2025–26 to March 29–April 2 in 2026–27.
Good Friday is listed separately on March 26 immediately before Spring Break. In 2025–26, Good Friday fell within Spring Break on April 3.
The calendar lists seven three-hour early-release dates, with the final two scheduled for June 3 and June 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When does CCPS start school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: Students in grades 1–5, 6, and 9 start Monday, August 24, 2026. Students in grades 7–8 and 10–12 start Tuesday, August 25. Pre-K and kindergarten follow a separate staggered schedule.

calendarFaqs.q: How do CCPS's two grade-based first days work?
calendarFaqs.a: CCPS uses a grade-based staggered opening. Grades 1–5, 6, and 9 begin August 24; grades 7–8 and 10–12 begin August 25. Families with children in different grade groups should plan for separate start dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When do CCPS Pre-K and kindergarten students start in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Pre-K and kindergarten students attend on school-assigned staggered days August 24–27. All Pre-K and kindergarten students begin attending daily Friday, August 28.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Thanksgiving Break for CCPS in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break runs Wednesday, November 25, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Students return Monday, November 30.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCPS Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Students return Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is CCPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 29, through Friday, April 2, 2027. Students return Monday, April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When are the three-hour early-release days for CCPS in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: CCPS lists three-hour early release on October 30, November 13, January 22, February 5, April 23, June 3, and June 4. Check your school’s bell and bus schedule for exact dismissal times.

calendarFaqs.q: Can the CCPS calendar change because of weather closures?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. CCPS may revise calendar dates or schedules after weather closures or other disruptions. Use the official CCPS calendar subscription for automatic updates and check district announcements before making time-sensitive plans.
